text:
Type: white picture ledge
Use: leaning frames, art prints and books against the wall; living room, bedroom, hallway, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white painted board, small brass-colored screw covers
Colors: white, brass dots
Shape: long narrow shelf with a raised front lip and low back panel, straight clean lines, slim and discreet, low profile
Feel: clean, gallery-like, light, tidy
Goes with: white walls, black or wood frames, art prints, light wood; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms

product.name: MOSSLANDA
product.description: The picture ledge has a special groove to keep smaller frames at the perfect angle.
